title: phippsia coarctata
intro: Phippsia coarctata, commonly known as Tibetan wormwood, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Caryophyllaceae. It has been traditionally used in Tibetan medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phippsia coarctata include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
